review_scope: Independent read-only detailed contract review. This verdict does not approve product/test implementation, service execution, database migration, or acceptance.

checks.source_pins: All source_pins in the candidate were recomputed from current local bytes and matched exactly. The pinned H2 source collection transitively pins original B03 backlog, requirements, acceptance cases (including AT-05/16/29 and REQ-05/14), workflow/state/data-model/OpenAPI/agent contracts and original-source manifest.
checks.original_scope: The candidate keeps AT-16 durable delivery in H2, scopes activation as a prerequisite rather than complete workflow execution, preserves AT-05 human work and AT-29 v1/v2 wait compatibility for later H3/H4/H5, and expressly keeps all original AT unexecuted. It preserves Paperclip's supervisory role, Temporal as the sole business-transition authority, AX server/ GET-only, and the original 17 contracts plus two uploads.
checks.schema_and_api: It directly addresses the present one-command-per-job limitation, create_command_id deferred route-constrained FK/backfill, create-only read joins, multi-command delivery rows, separate dispatcher/projector least privilege, and preserves external G4 current-auth receipt behavior distinct from internal projection receipt-first replay.
checks.security_and_ordering: The stated SCRAM login principals, session_user OID+name checks, owner registration, fixed SECURITY DEFINER search path/ACLs, sorted principal FOR SHARE fencing, project guard → membership NOWAIT → job → binding → task → outbox order, no network under DB locks, and static-run-fenced receipt replay align with the reviewed security advice. The explicit trust boundary does not claim SQL attests to Temporal RPC or arbitrary running code.
checks.recovery_and_phase_boundaries: The contract specifies finite same-ID unknown-start handling below verified retention, never reuses or replaces an admitted run, and separates H2 activation from H3 business transitions/H4 human APIs/H5 version-rollout acceptance/H6 cumulative regression. Historical 001/002 migration expectations and all351 Python regression IDs are explicitly retained while a current 003-chain gate is added.

blocking_findings.evidence: The argument-free read_dispatch_config() must resolve the caller's own approved deployment, namespace and server_config_sha256 before a new job has any execution_binding. execution_role_config specifies only four role OID/name pairs; engine_builds lists build hashes/type/queue but no explicit deployment/server configuration; worker_principals mentions deployment_id only indirectly in a uniqueness statement and does not define the caller-to-deployment lookup fields. The only stated server_config_sha256 storage is per-job execution_bindings, which is absent during dispatcher bootstrap/new-job selection. Consequently the contract does not identify the immutable owner-approved source of deployment identity/config or how a logged-in dispatcher is resolved to it before reserving a binding. This leaves the no-cross-endpoint/deployment guarantee and read_dispatch_config behavior underspecified at the security boundary.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Add an immutable owner-managed deployment registry (or define exact equivalent fields in a named existing table) with deployment_id, namespace and server_config_sha256 plus a uniqueness/immutability policy. Define exact FK associations from dispatcher principal and registered build/projector principal to that deployment, and specify how read_dispatch_config derives exactly one deployment from session_user OID+name and how reserve_execution copies/compares the registered deployment/config values into the binding. Preserve endpoint credentials outside the registry/history/public evidence. Re-pin and review the revised contract at a new SHA before authoring.

decision.required_next_step: Resolve H2-DEPLOYMENT-REGISTRY-UNDEFINED in a revised exact-SHA contract and obtain independent plus TC review of that same SHA.
decision.original_acceptance: AT-05, AT-16, AT-29 and all other original AT remain not_executed.

method_limits: Reviewed local contract/source bytes only. No tests, services, database, dependency changes or network activity were performed.
